name: Cable lateral raise
cue: Lean away and raise your elbow out to shoulder height.
research: research.json biomech.lateral_raise: single-arm cable lateral raise, right arm working, column on the left. Standing, leaning away from the column as one line from the feet (body line from the mid-feet to the neck 10.4 deg, research 10-15), free hand on the column grip. Stance (tools/design/lateral_raise.mjs with P=0 S1=7 S2=6 KL=10 KR=10 AL=12 AR=-12): the legs lean together (left hip abducted 12, right hip adducted 12) under a level pelvis and the trunk continues the line (lumbar 7 + thorax 6 to the right), so both ankles stay level at hip width with no knee split: mid-soles 0.098 H (17.4 cm, hip width) apart, knees 10 / 10, soles flat with 12 deg of inversion / eversion. The previous stance (pelvis tilted 6, feet 0.07 H apart, knees 6 / 14) read as tipping over on a phone. Working shoulder: humeral elevation 15 in a plane ~100 (hand in front of the groin, pulled across the body by the cable) -> ~98 thorax-relative in the scapular plane (~25), i.e. ~87 deg against the world vertical with the lean, so the elbow reaches shoulder height (1.5 cm below the shoulder joint) as the research cue asks; elbow 15 fixed, humerus neutral (thumb forward, palm down at the top), scapula depressed -5 -> 3. D-handle in the right fist (bone-attached, so the hand can never slip); its triangle swivels about the grip bar (hinge dswing on @hand_r, 44.9 -> -50.2 deg, measured so the apex points along the cable at the start and the peak, within 9 deg mid-rep); the cable runs from the low pulley at the left ankle diagonally across the front of the body.

camera.note: Research view az 15 / el 5 (front, toward the working arm), turned 20 deg further toward the working side and raised 20 deg (az 35 / el 25, 28 deg off the research view). The side delt faces out at the stretch and up at the peak; the turn shows it at the stretch and the higher lens looks down onto the contracted head at the peak. The lateral head runs from the acromion to the deltoid tuberosity and spans the middle of the cap (muscles_src delt_lat), so on the 390x481 phone stage it covers ~520 CSS px at the stretch and ~420 at the peak (the pushdown reference: ~240 / ~370; before this pass 351 / 224 at az 37 / el 17 with a narrower head), and the raised upper arm still reads level at the peak. fill 0.64 wins back glow area; swellGain 3.4 lets the contracted lateral head mound up.
